main_text.head: Appendix.
main_text.p: Participia transeunt quandoque in Particip. nomina, et illorum more construuntur, non ut participia, τὸ καθηκον σε, Officium tuum.

Et quandoque superuacue ponūtur, Particip. sic ut ipsis substractis eadē maneret sententia, ὤχόμλω ἀπίων, pro ὤχόμλω. οἴχεται ἀπιών, pro οἴχετα. παίζεις ἔχων, pro παίζς. φλυαρεῖς ἔχων, pro φλυαρεῖς. λπρεῖς ἔχων, pro λπρεῖς. τουτῷ ἔχων, pro τουτῷ, nunc. abundat.
main_text.head: CONSTRVCTIO ADVERBIORVM.
main_text.p: ADVERBIA sí post se casum habent, construuntur genitiuo, πόρρω τῆς πόλεως, εἰς τὸ μη- νὸς, λάθεα χωεῖς τῶν ἄλλων, φεῦ τῆς μεγέθους. Aduer.cū genitiuo.
Exceptis aduerbijs cōgregandi, quæ datiuo adhærēt, ἁμα τοῖς ἄλλοις. & Iuran Ad. cōgr.

page.notes: Greek text is printed in Greek letters and is transcribed as far as legible; some Greek words are doubtful and marked with [?] where uncertain. The woodcut initial A is joined to the word. Marginal catchwords are small and partly faint.
